question: What auspicious marks and adornments complete the description of this divine form?
premises: The form is endowed with all auspicious marks.
The form is possessed of all auspicious marks.
The form is adorned with a crown of matted hair.
inference: The divine form is fully marked by auspicious signs and crowned with matted hair.
uncertainties: The near-synonymous compounds emphasize completeness but may have subtle distinctions not explicit here.
plain_english: He is endowed with all auspicious marks, possessed of all auspicious marks, and adorned with a crown of matted hair.
